navigate_and_interact_page: navigate a page to a URL and click a button element by selector
locate_elements_by_role: locate DOM elements by ARIA role and accessible name for interaction
make_http_api_requests: send HTTP GET and POST requests with form data and retrieve JSON responses
capture_page_screenshot: capture a full-page PNG screenshot and save it to a file path
assert_page_element_state: assert that a page has a title and a locator is visible on the page
